name: M3_PMS100MI_SplitMO
description: Split a manufacturing order into two separate orders based on a specified operation and quantity. The original order keeps part of the quantity, and a new manufacturing order is created for the remaining part. You identify the order to split by facility, product number, manufacturing order number, and the operation that defines the split point. You also control how dates, times, priority, manual reclassification, and subcontracting behave for both the remaining and the new order. The response returns the generated manufacturing order number for the new order and the job number that identifies the related background job.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order to be split is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order to be split.

inputParameters.name: MFNO
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number to split into two orders.

inputParameters.name: OPNO
inputParameters.description: Operation number at which the manufacturing order is to be split.

inputParameters.name: KORQ
inputParameters.description: Order quantity to assign to the new manufacturing order created by the split.

inputParameters.name: OFDT
inputParameters.description: Finish date for the original manufacturing order after the split when entered manually.

inputParameters.name: OMFT
inputParameters.description: Finish time for the original manufacturing order after the split when entered manually.

inputParameters.name: OSTD
inputParameters.description: Start date for the original manufacturing order after the split when entered manually.

inputParameters.name: OMST
inputParameters.description: Start time for the original manufacturing order after the split when entered manually.

inputParameters.name: OMRE
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification date for the original manufacturing order after the split, if used.

inputParameters.name: OMCR
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification time for the original manufacturing order after the split, if used.

inputParameters.name: NFDT
inputParameters.description: Finish date to assign to the new manufacturing order created by the split.

inputParameters.name: NMFT
inputParameters.description: Finish time to assign to the new manufacturing order created by the split.

inputParameters.name: NSTD
inputParameters.description: Start date to assign to the new manufacturing order created by the split.

inputParameters.name: NMST
inputParameters.description: Start time to assign to the new manufacturing order created by the split.

inputParameters.name: NMRE
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification date for the new manufacturing order created by the split, if used.

inputParameters.name: NMRC
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification time for the new manufacturing order created by the split, if used.

inputParameters.name: PRIO
inputParameters.description: Priority of the new manufacturing order for planning and scheduling.

inputParameters.name: CRNS
inputParameters.description: Indicator specifying whether a new subcontract order should be created for the split order.

inputParameters.name: UDAT
inputParameters.description: Option controlling whether the start and finish date/time of the original manufacturing order are entered manually or copied from the existing order. For options that copy dates from the original order, the corresponding original date and time fields must be left blank.

inputParameters.name: BJNO
inputParameters.description: Batch job number to use when processing the split via autojob, if applicable.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number of the new order generated by the split.

outputParameters.name: BJNO
outputParameters.description: Batch job number associated with processing the split, if the split runs via autojob.
